obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

concrete.$description: Concrete — Dominant page canvas, section backgrounds, elevated surface wash

graphite.$description: Graphite — Dark surface panels, secondary dark fill, text on light cards

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline borders, subtle separators, box-shadow tint on cards

ash.$description: Ash — Visible borders, dividers between sections or card edges

smoke.$description: Smoke — Button hover borders, outline stroke, subtle elevation shadow base

slate.$description: Slate — Muted secondary text, icon strokes on light surfaces, metadata labels

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

aktiv-grotesk.$description: Sole typeface. Body text at 400 weight 16px with 1.5 line-height. Headlines scale dramatically to 64–96px at 400 weight with line-height 1.0 for poster-like impact. Nav and buttons use 500–700 at 14–16px. The dramatic size range and tight display leading are the signature — type is the only brand voice since color is absent.
